translation: Took place in posad Serock, 3 March [corrected from February] 1890, 9 PM. Appeared personally Abram Wajngrod, szkolnik, 60, and Moszek Zylbersztejn, trader, 33, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 5 PM in posad Serock died a child of male sex named Szlama Cukier[?], son of Chaim and of the mother Dwojra nee Antosiewicz[?], aged one and a half years. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by them and by us.
